description: State Ministry of Protection, Supply and Regulation of Pharmaceutical - Amended the Medicines (Ceiling on Prices) 2019, Medical devices Pricing No. 01 of 2017, 2018 and the Medical Devices Pricing Regulations No. 5 of 2017
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Health under the National Medicines Regulatory Authority Act, No. 5 of 2015. It specifically amends price control regulations for various medicines by providing a detailed schedule of maximum retail prices. This content falls under legal/regulatory matters as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks for pharmaceutical pricing.
